content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00312, SRS_Rte_00317 The associated Local Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references an ComIPdu which has its ComIPdu- Type parameter set to TP [SWS_COM_00919].

The associated RTE Implementation Plug-In shall pro- vide the Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyRxData Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references an LdComApiType which has its Ld- ComApiType parameter set to LDCOM_TP [SWS_LDCOM_00049].

The associated Local Software Cluster Communica- tion Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyRxData Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references an LdComApiType which has its Ld- ComApiType parameter set to LDCOM_TP [SWS_LDCOM_00049].
